40014699.author: पदार्थः
40014699.content: अथ: and then, दुर्धर्षः formidable one, श्रुतवान् one who heard, रामः Rama, वायुसुतस्य: son of wind god's, शृत्वा: having heard, प्रसन्नात्मा: highly pleased at heart, आत्मनि: his own, स्थितम् that which was in his mind, प्रत्यभाषत: started to tell.

40014699.author: Translation
40014699.content: Having heard Hanuman (son of wind god) formidable Rama was highly pleased at heart and started to tell his opinion.

40014700.author: पदार्थः
40014700.content: विभीषणंप्रति: about Vibheeshana, ममापि: even I, काचित् a few words, विवक्षा: desire to speak, आस्ति: is there, श्रेयसि: well wishers, स्थितैः are devoted, भवद्भिः you also, तत् that, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि: I desire.

40014700.author: Translation
40014700.content: "Even I desire to speak a few words about Vibheeshana. I wish you, who are my well wishers and devoted to me, also hear me."

40014701.author: पदार्थः
40014701.content: मित्रभावेन: with friendly feeling, सम्राप्तम् having come here, तस्य: his, दोष: defects, यद्यसि: although, कथञ्चन: however, नत्यजेयम् not reject, एतत् all this, सताम् good people, अगर्हितम् not reprehensible.

40014701.author: Translation
40014701.content: Although he (Vibheeshana) has defects, as he has come here with a friendly feeling, I cannot reject him. Good people are not reprehensible.

40014702.author: पदार्थः
40014702.content: अथ then, हरिपुङ्गवः leader of Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तद्वाक्यम् his statement, अभाष्यच and spoken by, विमृश्यच and reflecting upon, ततः thereafter, शुभतरम् favouring, वाक्यम् words, उवाचह said.

40014702.author: Translation
40014702.content: Then Sugriva, the leader of Vanaras reflecting on what was spoken by Rama said these words favouring Rama.

40014703.author: पदार्थः
40014703.content: एषः this, रजनीचरः night ranger, सुदुष्टोवा: be a wicked one, अदुष्टोवा: or not a wicked one, किम् what, यः with him, ईदृशम् such a person, व्यसनम् worry, प्राप्तम् has come here, भ्रातरम् when brother, परित्यजेत् had abandoned, तस्यएषः his this, यम् who, नपरित्यजेत् not abandon सः he, कोनाम: who will not, भवेत् do so.

40014703.author: Translation
40014703.content: "Let this Rakshasa (night ranger) be a wicked one or not a wicked one, what have we to worry about such a person? He has come here abandoned by his brother and who will not send away such a person? Who will not do so?"

40014704.author: पदार्थः
40014704.content: सत्यपराक्रमः one of truthful valour, काकुत्स्थ: of Kakuthsa dynasty, वानराधिपतेः of king of Vanaras, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा: on hearing, सर्वान् all, उदीक्ष्यतु: looking at, ईषत् slightly, उत्स्मयमानः throwing up a smile, पुण्यलक्षणम् meritorious characteristics, लक्ष्मणम् at Lakshmana, इति: these, वाक्यम् words, उवाचह: spoke.

40014704.author: Translation
40014704.content: On hearing the words of the king of Vanaras, Rama of Kakuthsa dynasty and of truthful valour looked at all and threw a smile slightly at meritorious Lakshmana and spoke these words.

40014705.author: पदार्थः
40014705.content: सत्यपराक्रमः one of truthful valour, काकुत्स्थ: of Kakuthsa dynasty, वानराधिपतेः of king of Vanaras, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा: on hearing, सर्वान् all, उदीक्ष्यतु: looking at, ईषत् slightly, उत्स्मयमानः throwing up a smile, पुण्यलक्षणम् meritorious characteristics, लक्ष्मणम् at Lakshmana, इति: these, वाक्यम् words, उवाचह: spoke.

40014705.author: Translation
40014705.content: On hearing the words of the king of Vanaras, Rama of Kakuthsa dynasty and of truthful valour looked at all and threw a smile slightly at meritorious Lakshmana and spoke these words.

40014706.author: पदार्थः
40014706.content: हरीश्वरः Lord of monkeys, यत् that which, उवाचह: has been said, ईदृशम् in this way, वक्तुम् to speak, शास्त्राणि: sastras, अनधीत्य: without studying, वृद्दान् elders, अनुपसेन्यच: to one who has served, नशक्यम् not possible.

40014706.author: Translation
40014706.content: "That which has been spoken by the Lord of monkeys in this way is not possible for one who has not studied sastras or served the elders."

40014707.author: पदार्थः
40014707.content: यत् that in this matter, सर्वराजसु: for all kings, प्रत्यक्षम् openly, विद्यते: known, लौकिकंचापि: even from worldly view, सूक्ष्मतरम् in subtle manner, किंचित् a little, अस्ति: is, अत्र: that, मे: to me, प्रतिभाति: strikes.

40014707.author: Translation
40014707.content: "It strikes me that in this regard, as it is openly known for all the kings or at least in a subtle manner from a worldly point of view."

40014708.author: पदार्थः
40014708.content: तत्कुलीनाश्च: of kings of same clan, प्रातिदेश्याश्च: kings of adjoining countries, अमित्रा: not friendly ones, व्यसनेषु: when in difficulties, प्रहर्तारः keep attacking, कीर्तिताः renowned, तस्मात् on account of this, अयम् he has, इह: here, आगतः come.

40014708.author: Translation
40014708.content: "When in difficulty kings of the same clan of adjoining countries keep attacking the renowned and so they are declared as enemies. It is on account of this cause he (Vibheeshana) has come here."

40014709.author: पदार्थः
40014709.content: अपापाः sinless one, तत्कुलीनाः of the same clan, स्वकान् of their own, हितान् friendly ones, मानयन्ति: respect, प्रायः by and large, नरेन्द्राणाम् of the kings, शोभनः virtuous ones, एषः in this way, शङ्कनीयः do not believe.

40014709.author: Translation
40014709.content: "The sinless ones respect the kings of their clan as friendly ones. But by and large such kings also do not believe the virtuous ones among the kings."

40014710.author: पदार्थः
40014710.content: अरिबलस्य: regarding the enemy's strength, आदाने: accepting, यः that which, दोषः demerit, त्वया: by you, प्रोक्तः you have spoken, तत्र: there, ते: to you, यथाशास्त्रम् What the scriptures say, कीर्तयिष्यामि: will narrate to you, इदम् this, शृणु: you may listen.

40014710.author: Translation
40014710.content: "I will tell you what the scriptures have said about the demerit in accepting an enemy's strength that you have spoken. You may listen."

40014711.author: पदार्थः
40014711.content: वयम् we, तत्कुलीनाःच: their clan, न: not, राक्षसः Rakshasas, राज्यकाङ् क्षीच: and desire for their (Rakshasa) kingdom, पण्डिताः learned, भविष्यन्ति: desires, तस्मात् on account of this cause, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, ग्राह्यः can be accepted.

40014711.author: Translation
40014711.content: "We do not belong to their clan. Among Rakshasas there are some learned ones. Vibheeshana has come because of his desire for their (Rakshasa) kingdom, perhaps ?"

40014712.author: पदार्थः
40014712.content: अव्यग्राश्च: free from anxiety, प्रहृष्टाश्च: satisfied, सङ्गताः with one another, नभविष्यन्ति: will not be, इति: this, भेदम् difference, गमिष्यन्ति: will have, अतः and that way, अस्य: his (Vibheeshana's), भयम् fear, आगतम् has come, एषः this way, प्रणादश्च: crying for help, महान् loudly, तस्मात् as such, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, ग्राह्यः worthy to accept.

40014712.author: Translation
40014712.content: "Kinsmen will not be satisfied with one another and are not free from anxiety. That way they will not be together. Vibheeshana who has come out of fear in this way crying loudly for help and is worthy to accept."

40014713.author: पदार्थः
40014713.content: तात: dear, सर्वे: all, भ्रातरः brothers, भरतोपमाः like Bharata, नभवन्ति: will not be, पितुः father, मद्विथाः like me, पुत्राः are sons, भवद्विधाः like you, सुहृदोवा: or friends.

40014713.author: Translation
40014713.content: "O dear All brothers cannot be like Bharata, all sons will not be like me, or all friends like you."

40014714.author: पदार्थः
40014714.content: रामेण: by Rama, एवम् in this way, उक्तः having spoken, महाप्राज्ञः very wise, सहलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, उत्थाय: got up, प्रणतः saluting, इदम् this, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoken.

40014714.author: Translation
40014714.content: When Rama had spoken that way, sagacious Sugriva along with Lakshmana got up and saluted him and spoke these words to Rama.

40014715.author: पदार्थः
40014715.content: क्षमवतांवर: exceptional in excusing, तम् him, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, रावणेन: by Ravana, प्रणिहितम् has been sent, अवेहि: Realize, तस्य: his, निग्रहम् captivate, क्षमम् befitting, मन्ये: I think.

40014715.author: Translation
40014715.content: "Rama, you are exceptional in excusing Vibheeshana. Realize that he has been dispatched here by Ravana. I consider befitting for you to captivate him."

40014716.author: पदार्थः
40014716.content: अनघ: sinless, महाबाहो: mightyarmed, आयंराक्षसः this Rakshasa, विश्वस्ते: I believe, त्वयि: you, प्रच्छन्नो: covertly, मयि: or me, लक्ष्मणेवा: at Lakshman too, प्रहर्तुम् strike, सन्दिष्टः is been sent, जिह्मया: greedily, बुद्ध्या: on knowing, इह: here, आगतः has come, सः he, सचिवैस्सह: along with his counsellors, बध्यः kill, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, नृशंसस्य: the cruel one, रावणस्यभ्राताहि: Ravana's brother, वाक्यज्ञः adept in expression, वाहिनीपतिः chief of the army, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वाक्यकुशलम् good at speech, रघुश्रेष्ठम् best of Raghu race, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा: having said, ततः then, मौनम् silent, उपागमत् remained.

40014716.author: Translation
40014716.content: "O sinless mightyarmed Rama I believe that this Rakshasa has been sent to come here covertly to strike at you or me or Lakshmana. On knowing that you are here the cruel Ravana's brother has come greedily along with his counsellors to kill you." Sugriva the chief of the army, who was good at speech and adept in expression, having said to Rama, the best among the Raghu race, remained silent thereafter.

40014717.author: पदार्थः
40014717.content: अनघ: sinless, महाबाहो: mightyarmed, आयंराक्षसः this Rakshasa, विश्वस्ते: I believe, त्वयि: you, प्रच्छन्नो: covertly, मयि: or me, लक्ष्मणेवा: at Lakshman too, प्रहर्तुम् strike, सन्दिष्टः is been sent, जिह्मया: greedily, बुद्ध्या: on knowing, इह: here, आगतः has come, सः he, सचिवैस्सह: along with his counsellors, बध्यः kill, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, नृशंसस्य: the cruel one, रावणस्यभ्राताहि: Ravana's brother, वाक्यज्ञः adept in expression, वाहिनीपतिः chief of the army, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वाक्यकुशलम् good at speech, रघुश्रेष्ठम् best of Raghu race, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा: having said, ततः then, मौनम् silent, उपागमत् remained.

40014717.author: Translation
40014717.content: "O sinless mightyarmed Rama I believe that this Rakshasa has been sent to come here covertly to strike at you or me or Lakshmana. On knowing that you are here the cruel Ravana's brother has come greedily along with his counsellors to kill you." Sugriva the chief of the army, who was good at speech and adept in expression, having said to Rama, the best among the Raghu race, remained silent thereafter.

40014718.author: पदार्थः
40014718.content: रामः Rama, सुग्रीवस्य: Sugriva's, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, विमृश्यतुततः that which was nobler, हरिपुङ्गवम् leader of the Vanaras, शुभतरम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, उवाच: spoken.

40014718.author: Translation
40014718.content: Having heard the words of the leader of Vanaras that were nobler, Rama spoke these auspicious words.

40014719.author: पदार्थः
40014719.content: एषः this, रजनीचरः night ranger, सुदुष्टोवा: wicked or, अदुष्टोवा: or not wicked, मम: to me, कथञ्चन: What to say, सूक्ष्मम् subtlest, अहितमपि: that which is harmful, कर्तुम् to do, आशक्तः capable.

40014719.author: Translation
40014719.content: "Whether this night ranger is wicked or not wicked, is he capable of doing even subtlest harm to me?"

40014720.author: पदार्थः
40014720.content: हरिगणेश्वर: leader of Vanara troop, इच्छान् if I desire, पृथिव्याम् on this earth, तान् them, पिशाचान् devils, दानवान् Danavas, यक्षान् Yakshas, राक्षसान्चैव: including Rakshasas, अङ्गुल्यग्रेण: with tip of my big finger, हन्याम् can kill.

40014720.author: Translation
40014720.content: "O leader of the Vanara troop If I so desire, I can kill with the tip of my big finger the devils, Danavas, Yakshas and the Rakshasas on this earth."

40014721.author: पदार्थः
40014721.content: कपोतेन: by a dove, शरणम् to seek refuge, आगतः came, शत्रुः enemy, यथान्यायम् according to practice, आर्चितश्च: offered, स्वैः its own, मांसैः flesh, निमन्त्रितश्च: without any jealousy, श्रूयतेहि: have heard.

40014721.author: Translation
40014721.content: "You have heard of the (story of a) dove that offered his own flesh to an enemy who came to seek protection according to tradition (of hospitality)."

40014722.author: पदार्थः
40014722.content: वानरश्रेष्ठ: supreme Vanara, सःकपोतः that dove, आगतम् came near, भार्याहर्तारम् carried away its mate, तम् him, प्रतिजग्राहहि: in turn received, मद्विधः like me, जनः a man, किंपुनः What more.

40014722.author: Translation
40014722.content: "O Supreme Vanara When the fowler who had carried away the mate came near the dove it received him and in turn protected him. What more can a man like me do?"

40014723.author: पदार्थः
40014723.content: पुरा: in the past, कण्वस्यऋषेः sage Kanva's, पुत्रेण: by the son, सत्यवादिना: truthful one, परमर्षिणा: great sage, कण्डुना: Kandu by name, धर्मिष्ठा: inculcating righteousness, गाथा: used to sing, गीता: verses, शृणु: you may listen.

40014723.author: Translation
40014723.content: "In the past Kanva's son called Kandu, a sage and a truthful one used to sing verses inculcating righteousness. (I shall recite) You may listen."

40014724.author: पदार्थः
40014724.content: परन्तप scorcher of enemies, बद्धाञ्जलिपुटम् who greets reverentially with folded hands, दीनम् piteous, याचन्तम् begs, शरणागतम् protection, शत्रुम् अपि even the enemy, अनृशंस्यार्थम् not to be cruel नहन्यात् not to be killed.

40014724.author: Translation
40014724.content: "O scorcher of enemies To one who greets reverentially with folded hands and begs for protection, we should not be cruel, and he is not to be killed."

40014725.author: पदार्थः
40014725.content: कृतात्माना one's own self, परेषाम् an enemy, शरणम् protection, गतः comes, अरिः enemy, आर्तोवा or one who is struck by suffering, यदिवा whoever he be, दृप्तः arrogant, प्राणान् life, परित्यज्य giving up, रक्षितव्यः should be protected.

40014725.author: Translation
40014725.content: An enemy who comes for protection against another enemy should be protected, even giving up one's own life whoever he may be, even if he is afflicted or arrogant.

40014726.author: पदार्थः
40014726.content: सः he, भयाद्वा: from fear, मोहाद्वा: from delusion, कामाद्वापि: even from desire, स्वया: his own, शक्त्वा: capacity, यथासत्त्वम् accordingly, नरक्षतिचेत् if he does not protect, तत् that, लोकगर्हितम् censured by the world, पापम् sin.

40014726.author: Translation
40014726.content: "If one does not protect, or give refuge, according to his capacity out of fear, desire (to gain) or delusion, the sin acquired by him will be censured by the world."

40014727.author: पदार्थः
40014727.content: शरणागतः one who seeks protection, अरक्षितः fails to protect, तस्य: his, रक्षिणः refugee, पश्यतः in the eyes of, विनष्टः ruined, तस्य: his, सर्वम् all, सुकृतम् merit, आदाय: takes, गच्छेत् away.

40014727.author: Translation
40014727.content: "One who fails to protect a refugee who seeks protection from him is ruined in the eyes of the refugee and he takes away all the merit."

40014728.author: पदार्थः
40014728.content: प्रपन्नानाम् resorts to, अत्रअरक्षणे: that way fails to protect, एवम् in that way, महान् great, दोषः sin, अस्वर्ग्यम् out of heaven, अयशस्यंच: and infamy, बलवीर्यविनाशनम् strength and virility gets lost.

40014728.author: Translation
40014728.content: "One who resorts to failure in protecting a refugee, will be doing a great sin that way and will be shut out of heaven, be infamy and his strength and virility will be lost."

40014729.author: पदार्थः
40014729.content: कण्डोः of Kandu, उत्तमम् excellent, वचनम् words, यथार्थम् meaningful, करिष्यामि: has said, धर्मिष्ठम् one who does his rightful duty, यशस्यम् glorious, स्वर्ग्यम् heaven, फलोदयेस्यात् will receive such result (after death).

40014729.author: Translation
40014729.content: "Excellent and meaningful words have been said by sage Kandu (about one who protects a refugee), that is by doing one's righteous duty. He will be not only famous but reach heaven as a result of his action."

40014730.author: पदार्थः
40014730.content: सकृदेव: for the sake of one, प्रपन्नाय: one who seeks protection, तव: him, अस्मि: me, इति: this way, याचते: begs, सर्वभूतेभ्यः from all living beings, अभयम् security, ददामि: will provide, एतत् thus, मम: my, व्रतम् vow.

40014730.author: Translation
40014730.content: "I will provide protection from all living beings for the one who seeks protection from me and begs in this way. This is my vow."

40014731.author: पदार्थः
40014731.content: हरिश्रेष्ठ: best of Vanaras, सुग्रीव: Sugriva, विभीषणोवा: either Vibheeshana, यदिवा: or any one, स्वयम् by himself, रावणः Ravana, अस्य: his, मया: from me, अभयम् security, दत्तम् will offer, एनम् thus, आनय: one who is unprotected.

40014731.author: Translation
40014731.content: "O best of Vanaras Sugriva Either Vibheeshana or any one by himself and even Ravana who is unprotected thus seeks security from me, I will offer protection."

40014732.author: पदार्थः
40014732.content: प्लवगेश्वरः king of (leaping) Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रामस्य: Rama's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, सौहार्देन: lovingly, प्रचोदितः inciting, काकुत्स्थम् Rama of Kakuthsa race, प्रत्यभाषत: replied.

40014732.author: Translation
40014732.content: Having heard the inciting words spoken by Rama so lovingly, the king of Vanaras replied.

40014733.author: पदार्थः
40014733.content: धर्मज्ञ: knower of righteous duty, लोकनाथसुखावहा: protector of the world, सत्त्ववान् virtuous one, सत्पथे: upright, स्थितः who stands, त्वम् by you, आर्यम् noble, प्रभाषेथाः that which was spoken, इतियत् thus which, अत्र: here, चित्रम् wonderful, किम् What.

40014733.author: Translation
40014733.content: "What wonderful words have been spoken by you, Rama? You are the knower of righteous duty, protector of the world, a virtuous and upright one."

40014734.author: पदार्थः
40014734.content: मम: my, अयम् this, अन्तरात्माच: inner self, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana's, शुद्धम् pure, वेत्ति: known, अनुमानात् च: and with doubt, भावात् feeling, सर्वतः in all respects, सुपरीक्षितः been tested.

40014734.author: Translation
40014734.content: "My inner self is aware that this Vibheeshana is pure. He has been tested in all respects with doubtful feelings."

40014735.author: पदार्थः
40014735.content: राघव: Rama, तस्मात् therefore, महाप्राज्ञः highly sagacious one, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, क्षिप्रम् at once, अस्माभिस्सह: along with us, तुल्यः equal term, भवतु: be, नः our, सखित्वंच: friendship, अभ्युपैतु: you enjoy.

40014735.author: Translation
40014735.content: "Rama therefore, let this highly sagacious Vibheeshana be with you like a friend in equal terms and enjoy."

40014736.author: पदार्थः
40014736.content: ततः then, नरेश्वरः king, तत् there, सुग्रीववचः Sugriva's words, निशम्य: perceiving, पुरन्दरः: like Indra, पतत्त्रिराजेनयथा like with the king of birds, विभीषणेन: with Vibheeshana, अशु: as said, हरीश्वरेण: by Sugriva, अभिहितम् very fitting, सङ्गमम् meeting, जगाम: went.

40014736.author: Translation
40014736.content: Perceiving Sugriva's befitting words, king Rama went to meet Vibheeshana like Indra arranged to meet with the king of birds. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टादशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the eighteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
